summary: Tested new 'Demandes à traiter' admin dashboard panel. Backend endpoint GET /api/dashboard/admin-requests works correctly with proper admin auth check. Full register→approve and forgot-password→send-temp flows verified. Frontend UI panel renders only for admins when total>0, with correct approve-user and send-temp buttons that remove items after action, and irregularite clicks navigate correctly (e.g. /stock).

minor.issue: Admin password change does not reset must_change_password flag. If admin uses this after send-temp-password to restore a user's password, the user is still forced to change it on next login. Consider clearing must_change_password on admin change.

action_items: (Minor, optional) In change_user_password, also $set must_change_password=false so admin-triggered password resets don't force a change on next login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (5764 lines) — consider splitting into routers by domain (users, dashboard, maintenance, ...) for maintainability.
PUT /api/users/{id}/password does not clear must_change_password (see minor issue above).
get_admin_requests iterates spare_parts one-by-one to count low stock; a MongoDB aggregate ($expr $lte) would be more efficient for large collections.
test_credentials: admin@hypermaint.fr / admin123 ; tech@hypermaint.fr / tech12345 (restored after tests)
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up TEST_ui_pending@example.com (pending user) and one pending password_reset_request for tech; both removed via approve/send-temp/delete. Tech password restored to tech12345 and must_change_password flag cleared in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint GET /api/dashboard/admin-requests returns {total, inscriptions[], reset_mdp[], irregularites[]} for admins (403 for non-admin). Frontend Dashboard.jsx shows data-testid=admin-requests only for isAdmin && adminRequests.total>0. Buttons use data-testid=approve-user-<uid>, send-temp-<reqId>, req-irregularite-<idx>. Note: page.evaluate fetch() may be blocked by PostHog recorder in this env — use python requests + inject token into localStorage to bypass, or use Playwright's page.request. Login form via page.fill/keyboard.type didn't set state in this environment (React controlled component + external script interference); recommended workaround: authenticate via python requests to /api/auth/login, then localStorage.setItem('token', ...) and localStorage.setItem('user', ...) before navigating.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. All targeted flows work end-to-end.
